summary: Feature verified end-to-end: Monthly Prize Drawing banner successfully moved from home page to a hidden /bi-weekly-contest page. Backend endpoint GET /api/prize-drawing/winners is public and returns the correct shape ({winners:[], count:N}) with limit clamping (1..100) and masked member IDs. Regression on /api/prize-drawing/status still works both with and without auth.
